summary: Blocker — grant-0 protection is race-prone. In src/services/groupService.js:39-45, deleting a group locks only that group before SectionDAO.isLastGrantGroup checks grant counts. If a private section has grants A and B, concurrent DELETE /groups/A and DELETE /groups/B transactions lock different rows, both observe two grants, and both soft-delete their section_groups rows in src/daos/groupDAO.js:45-55. The private section is left with zero structural grants, violating AC3/design_intent §7-A(F). Serialize this invariant on the affected section rows, or use an equivalent atomic database check, before removing grants. No feature unit tests cover this concurrency path; package.json still has only the failing placeholder test script.
